purpose: Cover US-17406 (D6 bites) and US-17504 (probe seam and litmus): the four new consistency scans each have pass, fail and the named false-positive guards; countLitmusReadersAtHash reads distinct readers from probe-ledger entries at the current hash; parseLitmusFlag validates input; the readiness CLI --litmus flag exits 4 on a shortfall and documents the flag in --help; computeReadiness returns the pre-PR result when no probeRunner is passed and merges injected findings into open probe entries when one is.
title: DEFINE step 3 PR 7: D6 consistency scans, probe seam, --litmus and rcf_define_litmus

testCases.description: Two ACs on one story sharing a when clause and a negated then fail consistency:contradictions with the story id and both AC ids in the why.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 7, AC-17406-1): contradictions fails a story with two ACs sharing a when and a negated then

testCases.description: A negation inside a double-quoted substring in a then does not fire consistency:contradictions on the story.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 7, AC-17406-6): contradictions does not fire on a negation inside a quoted substring

testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 7, AC-17406-2): unsatisfiable fails an AC naming a field no recordShape defines

testCases.description: A field defined in a [draft] recordShape counts as defined; consistency:unsatisfiable passes the AC.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 7, AC-17406-3): unsatisfiable passes when the field lives in a [draft] recordShape

testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 7, AC-17406-4): duplicates fails identical AC descriptions across stories
